names.note: STORED AS THE PAGE PRINTS IT, DEFECT AND ALL. The calendar’s own name page for him reads «Михаил (Плеьнев), мч.», with a soft sign where a т belongs: his father’s name page two links earlier reads «Евграф (Плетнев)» and the line calls him «сына его», his son, so the surname is Плетнев and the form here is a typographical fault on the source page. It is kept verbatim rather than corrected, because a name form is copied and never emended; the display name follows the father’s link. The day line itself gives only «мч. Михаила».

death.note: The year the day line closes with, «(1918)», which is the whole of what the source gives; no year of birth anywhere.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 10 декабря ст. ст. — «Сщмчч. Иакова и Александра пресвитеров, сщмч. Евграфа пресвитера и сына его мч. Михаила (1918).»

attestations.note: The fourth of the four one line enumerates, and the one the line puts in a relation: «сына его», the son of the third. «Мч.» is мученик, a martyr with no priestly grade, and the name page repeats it and adds nothing, so he is recorded as a layman. THE LINE AND THE NAME PAGES ARE ALL THERE IS. HIS NAME PAGE CARRIES A TYPOGRAPHICAL DEFECT, «Плеьнев» for «Плетнев», and the stored form keeps it; the `names` note has the whole of the reading. No folder held him. The day page prints eleven hymns and none is under any of these names.
